title: Sforza chancery letter in cipher, cart. 1597 (DECODE R5464)

documents.shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Milano, Carteggio Visconteo-Sforzesco, Potenze sovrane, Cancelleria segreta, Chiavi e cifrari, cart. 1597, stamped leaves 158-159

plaintext.source: No decipherment found; the key sheets in the box are 19th-century reconstructions.

transcription.source: signreader.py: sign detection and clustering on the DECODE images (1,671 px wide)
transcription.notes: Signs 15-25 px tall; dots 2-3 px. About 10% of signs mis-read; hand pass on P1 (all 50 lines) and P2 lines 1-3.

system.summary: Homophonic substitution with graphic signs (about 60 signs for the Italian alphabet), no word division; family of signs differs between letters of the box.
system.notes: Dots distinguish sign variants; the 115 key sheets of the box are 19th-century reconstructions and none was matched.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment found in DECODE, Tomokiyo or the literature checked.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: the user set the goals, approved downloads (CTTS) and asked for the hand pass.

solution.what: Fetched all 174 cart. 1597 records from DECODE (115 key sheets, 59 ciphertexts).
Built a sign reader (deskew, line strips, connected components, dot attachment, Ward clustering) after the CTTS reader failed on these scans.
CTTS homophonic solver run headless on the sign tokens with period Italian, Latin and other corpora.
Shuffled-token runs and simulated Italian ciphers with 0, 8 and 15% sign noise: real/shuffled score ratio 1.65 for Italian against Latin 1.38, Spanish 1.36, French 1.32.
Word-guided key refinement, token pair rules and a hand correction pass on P1 and P2 lines 1-3; dictionary-word coverage rose 10.9% to 24.2%.
Only short stretches build Italian words (dele letere, gravisima, tornare, desiderio); no sentence-level reading.

outcome.method_basis: Language is Italian (controls), but the sign reader and 60-homophone key give only 24% dictionary-word coverage; no sentences build.
outcome.notes: Image resolution (15-25 px signs) is the limit; the unsent request to ASMi asks for 400 dpi images of leaves 158-159 and 164-165.
